title: Pocket pause
subtitle: Choose a small pause. Your book can wait.

cards.title: Take a breath
cards.detail: Soften your shoulders. Breathe in slowly, then let it out.

cards.title: Stand up and move
cards.detail: Stand up if you can. Stretch gently, then take a few steps.

cards.title: Drink some water
cards.detail: Take a few unhurried sips of water. Pause before your next page.
